evals.prompt: We just wrapped discovery with Halden Structural. The analysis is in evals/files/halden-structural-analysis.md. Build the client deck for Thursday's meeting with their engineering director (2026-09-24). Keep it tight, she has 30 minutes.
evals.expected_output: An English deck of 7 to 11 slides in the R²XTECH design system (pale cover and closing with the geodesic, warm argument slides), leading with the revision or connection-check finding, proposing the Connection Pipeline as a named program with at most three parts, the pilot and open questions surfaced, every figure traceable to the analysis with a confidence label, no em dashes, presenter notes on every slide.
expectations: The deck is a single deck.html in the outputs folder
The static check reports no FAIL (em dashes, notes, placeholders, assets, script)
Every slide has presenter notes
No em dash anywhere in copy, notes or labels
Between 7 and 11 slides
No slide carries more than 90 words on screen
Every number on screen appears in the analysis
Uses the R²XTECH design system (warm tokens plus at least two pale slides)
Cover and closing play the geodesic from the shared frames
Names the proposed program (Connection Pipeline) on screen
Figures carry confidence labels (Measured / Reported)
Surfaces the pilot and the IDEA StatiCa API question
Deck is in English (html lang=en)
A report.md was written for the user
